detail.zh-Hans: AI 搜索、AI 助手与 Agent、AI 训练三类爬虫可以分别设置拦截方式，还能按偏好自动生成 robots.txt；新增会话级机器人检测（Precursor）。
detail.en: Set AI Search, AI Assistants & Agents and AI Training crawlers separately, and let Cloudflare generate robots.txt from your preferences. Session-level bot detection (Precursor) is new too.

detail.zh-Hans: 自动汇总 Worker 的未捕获异常、5xx 响应和错误日志，可以标记为已解决或忽略；Worker 详情里还能看到预览地址。
detail.en: Uncaught exceptions, 5xx responses and error logs from your Workers are grouped into issues you can resolve or ignore. Worker details now list preview URLs too.

detail.zh-Hans: 一键扫描域名的安全隐患，按严重程度查看和处理。
detail.en: Scan a domain for security issues in one tap, then review and dismiss them by severity.

detail.zh-Hans: 新增访问明细（国家/地区、状态码、路径、主机名）与安全事件。
detail.en: New Traffic Breakdown by country or region, status code, path and hostname, plus Security Events.

detail.zh-Hans: 缓存可以「标记过期」，交给源站校验后再更新；新增缓存响应规则；WAF 与缓存规则保存前可以先校验。
detail.en: Mark cached content as stale so it revalidates with your origin instead of being purged. Cache Response Rules are new, and WAF and cache rules can be validated before you save.

detail.zh-Hans: 支持欧盟、美国数据驻留的 R2 存储桶和 KV 命名空间，R2 可看上传与下载带宽；DNS 标出被 NS 委派遮蔽的记录；可以搜索新域名并查看价格。
detail.en: R2 buckets and KV namespaces with EU or US data residency are supported, and R2 shows upload and download bandwidth. DNS flags records shadowed by an NS delegation, and you can search for new domains with prices.

detail.zh-Hans: 免费套餐不再显示开不了的 AI 内容开关；权限不足时可以直接查看所需权限；D1 超出免费额度时给出明确说明；编辑 DNS 记录时不再能修改类型（Cloudflare 已不支持）。
detail.en: AI content switches that can’t be turned on are hidden on the Free plan, permission errors link to the permissions you need, and D1 explains when the free daily limit is reached; editing a DNS record no longer lets you change its type, which Cloudflare no longer allows.

detail.zh-Hans: 用 Cloudflare 官方授权登录，无需手动粘贴 API Token；一个 App 可同时登录多个身份与账号，随时切换。
detail.en: Sign in with Cloudflare's official authorization — no API tokens to paste. Keep several identities and accounts signed in and switch anytime.

title.en: Domains, DNS and the rules hub

detail.zh-Hans: 域名列表与详情、DNS 记录增删改查、WAF 与速率限制、缓存与 Transform、单条重定向与 Page Rules，都在手机上完成。
detail.en: Browse domains, manage DNS records, WAF and rate limiting, cache and transform rules, single redirects and Page Rules — all from your phone.

title.zh-Hans: 开发者平台与实时日志

detail.zh-Hans: Workers、Pages、Queues、Durable Objects、Hyperdrive、Workers AI 与 AI Gateway 收在一个 Tab；Worker 实时日志支持搜索、级别筛选与暂停。
detail.en: Workers, Pages, Queues, Durable Objects, Hyperdrive, Workers AI and AI Gateway share one tab, and Worker live logs support search, level filters and pause.

title.zh-Hans: R2、D1 与 KV 随身管理
title.en: R2, D1 and KV in your pocket

detail.zh-Hans: 浏览 R2 存储桶与对象、跑 D1 SQL 查询并直接改行、读写 KV 键值；大表有截断与分页防线，不怕手机内存吃紧。
detail.en: Browse R2 buckets and objects, run D1 SQL and edit rows in place, read and write KV pairs — with truncation and paging guards so large tables stay safe on a phone.

title.zh-Hans: 随时间走的晨昏界面与桌面卡片
title.en: A daybreak interface and home-screen cards

detail.zh-Hans: 整个 App 的天色随你所在时刻从清晨走到深夜；桌面服务卡片提供「天窗」与「山脊」两张，账号总览一眼可见。
detail.en: The whole app's sky follows your local time from dawn to night, and two home-screen cards — skylight and ridge — keep your account overview one glance away.
